title: Grateful Dead Live at Veterans' Memorial Coliseum on 1984-04-24
lineage: Sony TCD5M (original record deck - Dolby on) > Pre Sonus Inspire GT > Sound Forge > .wav files > Trader's Little Helper > flac and ffp files
source: source: 3 Beyer M160 microphones (13th row) > Nak MX100 w/2001 > Sony TCD5M (Dolby on) - analog master cassettes;

ai_review.summary: Sweet ribbon‑mic recording captures a tight first set and a dynamic, tight second set, making this favorite show enjoyable.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance – a businesslike first set followed by a surprisingly dynamic and tight second set. The recording benefits from Beyer M‑160 ribbon microphones, delivering a sweet, clear tone that stands out among the few available tapes of this concert.

ai_rating.rationale: High praise for both the musical performance and the microphone‑derived sound quality; limited to two reviews, so confidence is medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Ribbon Beyer M‑160 mics provide a sweet, clear tone with no reported distortion or dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as businesslike and solid; second set noted as especially dynamic and tight, indicating strong pacing throughout.
